definitions: To experience a strong sense of guilt or impropriety despite knowing an action is permissible.
To have a sensation of doing something wrong or forbidden, even when it is not.
To feel an unexpected thrill or naughtiness from a mundane or allowed activity.
examples: Eating dessert for breakfast feels illegal.
Taking a nap in the middle of the workday feels illegal.
Using a self-checkout for just one item feels illegal.
Wearing pajamas all day feels illegal.
Getting a really good deal on something feels illegal.
